title: tc-inspect-frame
description:
A component seen like a selection in a design tool – tilted back, with a selection frame, spacing numbers and a
guide walking through its rows. Its content is its first element child.

label.description: Accessible name; without it the illustration is decorative and hidden from screen readers

targets.description: CSS selector for the rows to walk through, inside the content; "" (the default) picks the root's block children

playing.description: Walks the selection through the rows; false holds it on the first row

hold.description: How long the selection stays on a row, in ms

delay.description: Wait before the first selection, in ms – e.g. until the section around it has come in

rounds.description: How many times it walks through the rows before it rests on the first one

mirror.description: Tilted the other way and fading out to the left – for the left side of a layout

contentWidth.description: The content's width in px, before it's scaled to fit the frame
